tasks.short: Select hardware that meets the specification.

steps.what: List specification limits before selecting hardware.
Check each candidate material against those limits.
Select hardware and material that meet product requirements.
Confirm the shortlist still fits the product.
Send the hardware selection note to procurement.

tasks.design: Limits from the specification on {DOCS} are checked as fields: present, and inside the limit. The computer hardware engineer still selects the hardware and material, and confirms the shortlist with a colleague. {PROCUREMENT} receives the note only after that selection. Nothing orders a part by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Compliance was a marked-up spreadsheet, and the buy sometimes started from an old mark.
tasks.enabler_now: A limit check can be repeated. Choosing the part when several pass cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Two parts that both pass and only one that will actually work.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which passing part fails in this product.

ambition.what: The engineer decides which passing part is the one procurement may buy.

tasks.altitude: The limit check is shorter. The selection stays. A note cannot go out before that decision.

reach.task: Say whether a selected part fits the chassis
reach.learn: Which fit problems a limit check never shows

evidence.claim: Requirements and verification status can be kept as records. That tracking does not choose the part or the design.
A cost line can be a quantity times a price the buyer maintains. The engineer still chooses the part.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from an issued specification to a selection note. Placing the purchase order is the buyer's task.
Fields are part id, limit name, limit value, candidate value and unit. The specification produces the limits. Fallback: a candidate with no value is left unmarked and cannot be sent.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 2.2 hours per 100 baseline hours is the limit list.
unknowns: Whether procurement already blocks a part with a missing limit.
Who may add a candidate that is not on the approved list.
research_questions: How often do two parts pass and only one work?
How often is a part ordered from an old note?

incremental.description: Maintain the limit list used for selection

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: few parts pass cleanly and the selection meeting dominates. High case: the limit marks are ready and the engineer only chooses and confirms.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Store capability measurements for later analysis.
Retrieve the named system capability fields.
Choose the cut that answers the capability question.
Manipulate the retrieved data into that cut.
Discuss the capability result with the project team.

tasks.design: Capability measurements are stored once on the {DATA_PLATFORM}, with name, value, unit and source record. A named retrieve and the cut the computer hardware engineer chose can be repeated. Choosing which cut answers the question, and the meeting about it, stay with the engineer. A question the fields cannot answer is not given a guessed table.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same measurements were copied into a new sheet for every question.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored row can be retrieved again. Deciding which cut is honest cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A cut that is numerically right and answers the wrong question.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which average hides a failing unit.

ambition.what: The engineer decides which cut of capability data is fit to show.

tasks.altitude: Copying rows shrinks. The choice of cut and the meeting stay.

reach.role: Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technologists and Technicians
reach.task: Record a capability measurement with its unit and the setup used
reach.learn: Which fields they leave blank when the setup was unusual

evidence.claim: Requirements and verification status can be kept as records. That tracking does not choose the part or the design.
Design, bench work, assembly, supervision and teaching stay with the engineer. A draft is not a signed design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from stored measurements to a cut discussed with the project team. Designing the hardware is out of scope.

Fields are measurement name, value, unit, product id and source record. The test record produces them. Fallback: the engineer types a row and marks it manual, and it is excluded from a named retrieve until checked.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 2.5 hours per 100 baseline hours is the field list and the named retrieves.
unknowns: Whether the measurements already live in one store.
Who is allowed to change a stored value.
research_questions: What share of questions repeat a previous cut?
How often does the meeting reject the cut?

incremental.description: Maintain capability fields and named retrieves

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: each question needs a new cut and a meeting. High case: the retrieve is ready and only the choice and the meeting remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Hear the requester describe hardware needs.
Write the hardware needs as structured fields.
Draft a recommendation of appropriate hardware.

loop.input: Need fields and the issued specification
loop.output: A recommendation that names only those parts
loop.check: Each named part is in the specification or the draft is rejected
loop.stop: One draft, then the engineer edits
loop.why_not_simpler: The need is a conversation and the allowed parts are already listed

steps.what: Decide which hardware to recommend.
Send the hardware recommendation to the product manager.

tasks.design: The conversation about needs stays. Needs are then fields on {DOCS}: workload, environment, count and constraint. A draft may name only hardware already in the issued specification, and the computer hardware engineer decides the recommendation before it goes to the product manager. The note stays inside the team, so it is not a purchase.
tasks.previous_blocker: Needs were a meeting and the recommendation was rewritten from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: A field list and a draft can be reused. The decision of what is appropriate cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A need the requester cannot yet state, which changes the hardware.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer hears the constraint the requester did not write down.

ambition.what: Product managers who previously had only a hallway conversation get a written recommendation.

tasks.altitude: The write-up is shorter. The engineer still hears the need and still decides the hardware.

reach.task: Describe how people will use the hardware
reach.learn: Which needs a specification field never captures

evidence.claim: A specification can be filled from records, with prose drafted around those figures. Every number has to trace to a record, and the engineer signs.
Design, bench work, assembly, supervision and teaching stay with the engineer. A draft is not a signed design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from a requester's description to an internal recommendation. Buying the hardware is out of scope.
Fields are workload, environment, count, constraint and must-have or nice-to-have. The engineer writes them from the conversation. Fallback: the recommendation is written with no draft.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours is the need field list.
unknowns: Whether product managers will fill the need fields themselves.
Which recommendations later become purchase requests.
research_questions: How often does the conversation change the written need?
What share of recommendations name a part that is not in the specification?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the need is unclear and the meeting is the work. High case: the need fields are complete and the engineer only decides. The hearing stays either way.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the reporting formats the hardware must support.
Price the bill from the maintained cost table.
Judge security restrictions the price table cannot waive.
Determine the hardware configuration from those factors.
Issue the hardware configuration for the build.

tasks.design: Reporting formats are a list on {DOCS}. Cost lines are quantities times a price table the buyer maintains, calculated without a new model. Security restrictions are not waived by that table. The computer hardware engineer determines the configuration and issues that version for the build.
tasks.previous_blocker: Format, cost and security lived in three files and were reconciled in a meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: A price extension can be repeated. The security judgement and the configuration cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A cheaper configuration that breaks a security restriction.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which restriction is real for this product and which is habit.

ambition.what: The engineer decides whether a cheaper configuration breaks a security restriction.

tasks.altitude: The arithmetic is shorter. The configuration decision stays, and nothing is issued before it.

reach.task: State which security restrictions a configuration must keep
reach.learn: Which restrictions they will not treat as optional

evidence.claim: A cost line can be a quantity times a price the buyer maintains. The engineer still chooses the part.
The engineer who signs stays responsible for the design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from format, cost and security inputs to one issued configuration. Ordering the parts is out of scope.

Fields are format name, quantity, unit price, currency, restriction name and whether it is mandatory. The buyer maintains prices. The engineer writes the restrictions. Fallback: a missing price is left blank and that line is excluded.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 2.5 hours per 100 baseline hours is the price-table link and the restriction list.
unknowns: Whether the buyer will keep the price table current.
research_questions: How often does cost pressure ask for a restriction to be dropped?
How often is the issued configuration changed after the build starts?

incremental.description: Maintain the restriction list and the price link

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: security and format are both contested, so the decision dominates. High case: prices are current and the engineer only judges the restrictions and the configuration.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Part selection and configuration stay with the engineer. Limit checks and stored measurements are shorter to repeat. Meetings about the result remain.
reach: Mechanical Engineers, on fit problems a limit check never shows.
Human Factors Engineers and Ergonomists, on needs a field does not capture.
skills_to_grow: Choosing among parts that all pass.
Deciding which data cut is fit to show.
role.ambitious_version: Procurement receives a selection only after the engineer has chosen, and a product manager gets a recommendation that names parts already specified.
